title: SoulSpec Persona Manifest
description: JSON Schema definition for SoulSpec v1.0 cognitive persona packages.

$schema.description: URI of the SoulSpec JSON schema specification.

name.description: Unique lowercase identifier slug for the soul persona.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the persona.

version.description: Semantic version string of the persona package.

author.description: Author, organization, or team responsible for creating the persona.

archetype.description: High-level cognitive role, archetype, or domain specialization.

description.description: Comprehensive summary of the persona's role, behavioral heuristics, and philosophy.

tags.description: Categorical tags and keywords associated with this persona.

cognitive_params.description: LLM inference hyperparameters tailored for this persona's cognitive style.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature for output randomness and creativity.

allowed_tools.description: List of tool IDs that this persona is permitted to invoke.
